messages.text: Sunday, September 27 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, full moon, and jazz echoes
A mild, overcast Sunday offers a mix of local arts and music events, alongside a significant urban development story from Ann Arbor. The moon is full, a bright presence in the autumn sky.
Today will be overcast with a high near 75°F and a low around 49°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:27 AM and sunset is at 7:22 PM, with the full moon 99.5% illuminated.
Sunday's nearby sounds and sights

In Ann Arbor, catch the Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club starting at 2 PM, or experience the Women in Jazz Showcase at Blue LLaMA Jazz Club at 6 PM. For an artistic reception, visit Kerrytown Concert House for Esther Kirshenbaum's 'A Symphony of Seeing' at 4 PM.
My Birthday is coming up on September 30.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown sale proceeds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated across 12 distinct projects.
Tomorrow and beyond

Tomorrow, consider the Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit at YDL-Superior or the 'FALL GARDENING CHORES' session at YDL-Whittaker at 2 PM. On September 28, Willi Carlisle performs at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8 PM.
Satellites navigate without GPS; telescopes prepare for launch

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has completed its flight-readiness review and is proceeding toward final launch preparations.
The Starship schedule is unset, with no official launch date listed.
May your day unfold with quiet discoveries.
Monday, September 28 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn Sun, Full Moon, and a Symphony of Sounds

Partly cloudy skies will offer a pleasant autumn feel today, with a high near 76°F. The day's most notable local thread is the Ypsilanti Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit, while science news highlights NASA's Starling satellites achieving GPS-free navigation.
Expect partly cloudy conditions with a high near 76°F and a low around 51°F; there is no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:28 AM and sunset is at 7:20 PM, under a full moon that is 96.9% illuminated.
Local and Nearby Events Today

The Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit at YDL-Superior offers a free look into local food growers' stories. For music lovers, Spiral Galaxy, Viands, and Matthew Smith perform at Trinosophes in Detroit at 7:30 PM.
Mark your calendars for September 30, which includes both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor's Plan for Downtown Property Sale Funds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. These funds are designated for 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Looking Ahead to Tomorrow and Beyond
Tomorrow offers the "AI for the Everyday" workshop at Farmington Library at 6:00 PM, and a "Black Reading Month Fireside Chat" at Howard Family Bookstore in Detroit at 6:00 PM.
Satellites Navigate Without GPS, Hubble Finds Ancient Collision

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. Meanwhile, the Hubble telescope has identified a major merger from the Milky Way’s infancy, evidence of an ancient collision with a dwarf galaxy.
The schedule for the next Starship launch is unset, with estimates suggesting no earlier than September 18, 2026.
May your day be one of quiet discovery and gentle unfolding.
